proposal: fix('SWE', 'Kölvallen wind farm', G, '補上商轉年 2025 並更正容量、機組與業主：Arise 的 Kölvallen 風場共 42 部 Siemens Gamesa 風機、277.2 MW，2022 年 7 月售予 Foresight Group 管理的基金（Arise 保留約 9%），Arise 2025 年第三季報告說 Kölvallen 已完工，生產部門頁面說它 2025 年為 SE2 電價區新增 277 MW。原寫 96.6 MW、年份不詳', 'Commissioning year 2025 added, capacity, turbines and owner corrected: Arise’s Kölvallen farm has 42 Siemens Gamesa turbines, 277.2 MW, sold in July 2022 to a fund managed by Foresight Group (Arise keeps about 9%); Arise’s Q3 2025 report speaks of the completion of Kölvallen and its production page says the project added 277 MW to price area SE2 in 2025. note_zh: 補上商轉年 2025 並更正容量、機組與業主：Arise 的 Kölvallen 風場共 42 部 Siemens Gamesa 風機、277.2 MW，2022 年 7 月售予 Foresight Group 管理的基金（Arise 保留約 9%），Arise 2025 年第三季報告說 Kölvallen 已完工，生產部門頁面說它 2025 年為 SE2 電價區新增 277 MW。原寫 96.6 MW、年份不詳
note_en: Commissioning year 2025 added, capacity, turbines and owner corrected: Arise’s Kölvallen farm has 42 Siemens Gamesa turbines, 277.2 MW, sold in July 2022 to a fund managed by Foresight Group (Arise keeps about 9%); Arise’s Q3 2025 report speaks of the completion of Kölvallen and its production page says the project added 277 MW to price area SE2 in 2025. proposal: (no rule yet) candidate: year=2012
note_zh: 補上商轉年 2012（待確認）：STEG 的 Bizerte 風場共 143 部風機、分在 Metline 與 Kchabta 兩處，約 190 MW；2019 年 TAP 報導說 Metline-Kchabta 風場「2012 年設置」，Metline 站有 72 部、95 MW
note_en: Commissioning year 2012 (to be confirmed): STEG’s Bizerte farm has 143 turbines on two sites, Metline and Kchabta, about 190 MW; a 2019 TAP report says the Metline-Kchabta farm was “set up in 2012”, with 72 turbines and 95 MW at Metline
why: Not written: the farm was built in two stages (120 MW / 91 turbines, then 26 more turbines per site), so each site’s full capacity is the extension year. The site’s own IRENA series for Tunisia rises 54 → 173 (2012) → 200 (2013) → 233 (2014) → 240 (2015) MW, which suggests the extension was finished 2013–2015, not 2012. No STEG annual report or extension commissioning notice found; thewindpower leaves the date blank.

proposal: fix('JPN', 'Banya wind farm', G, '補上商轉年 2004 並更正容量與機組：環境省 2020 年說南薩摩市「番屋風力發電所」有 10 部運轉中的風機（鹿兒島風力發電研究所計畫汰換）；NEDO 的鹿兒島縣一覽列南薩摩市（舊坊津町）風力發電研究所 10 部 Vestas 1,750 kW、共 17,500 kW，2004 年 3 月運轉，是該市唯一的 10 部風場', 'Commissioning year 2004 added, capacity and turbines corrected: in 2020 the Ministry of the Environment described the “Banya wind farm” in Minamisatsuma as 10 operating turbines (to be replaced by Kagoshima Wind Power Research); NEDO’s Kagoshima list gives the Wind Power Research farm at Minamisatsuma (former Bōnotsu), 10 Vestas 1,750 kW units, 17,500 kW, running from March 2004 — the only 10-turbine farm in the city', 'https://www.nedo.go.jp/library/fuuryoku/case/pref_46.html', year=2004, mw=17.5, turbine='10 x Vestas 1.75 MW'),

note_en: Commissioning year 2004 added, capacity and turbines corrected: in 2020 the Ministry of the Environment described the “Banya wind farm” in Minamisatsuma as 10 operating turbines (to be replaced by Kagoshima Wind Power Research); NEDO’s Kagoshima list gives the Wind Power Research farm at Minamisatsuma (former Bōnotsu), 10 Vestas 1,750 kW units, 17,500 kW, running from March 2004 — the only 10-turbine farm in the city
